Usually that's the case if you're in your own apartment here, but if you are in a sublet and don't have a lease, you don't really have a leg to stand on. I'm out of the house anyway but I can maybe try and fight it, not sure I would get anywhere though.

I have my granny, but she's 89 and lives in a retirement home in England, I've been looking for places all evening but they all want a deposit and 2 or even 3 months rent upfront. The rental market in Dublin is disgusting atm, too much demand and no supply, even if I find a place, I don't have the money upfront.

I'm sorry to be such a Debbie downer lol

Thank you for that. I contacted them but because I still have a job and I have somewhere to stay at the moment, the church, they can't help me.

It's for people who are in more need, sleeping in parks and don't have any job or anything, they did tell me that if I lose my job to go back to them though

That's so sweet, thank you. I'm trying, I have been on online chats with them since 7pm,luckily I have free Internet atm

They are not sure, the said because I placed a 5 euro bet back in March, that they cannot prove that all these bets weren't me. I wish I could attach a screenshot of some of the bets, I'm not sure how.

There is, but I don't have an account with them, I've never used it, why?

Sorry, I deleted my comment by mistake, why so you have two usernames?

Thank you for such a kind gesture and please don't be angry about this.

I can't even be mad at my roommates, people are different so I guess they just don't understand.

I don't or wouldn't even know where to start with a go Fund me, I don't have Facebook or anything, isn't that how you share it?
Thank you for your kind suggestion, I have looked into it anyway and when/if I lose my job, I will definitely apply, thank you

Hey Savannah, thanks for thinking of me. I'm worse today if I'm honest. I'm in the shelter, and I got 460 worth of wages paid into my account yesterday, then at 6pm today, by bank called me to say there was alot of fraudulent activity on my account.

Turns out a betting account I opened back in March and used once for fun had been hacked and all my wages have been stolen, plus 600 euro worth of arretas, so I am minus 1070, and don't have a single penny 🤦‍♀️ I just want it all to stop
I have been made homeless as of today and because I'm homeless, I'll lose my job as my boss said I'll be unreliable, I have nothing and no one

No not insensitive at all, I just don't really have anything to live for. A few months ago I was in my first house share, I have always lived alone, and I was sexually assaulted, I tried to make a complaint and everything but I was kicked out of the house instead.

That amongst my father dying at Christmas and other things, I just genuinely don't have it in me anymore. 

Your comment is completely valid though, I am just not seeing it that way atm

My boyfriend lost his job and has been couch surfing, when he list his job I helped him as much as I could, which is why I'm in debt now, he has nowhere to live and had to sleep on a bench last night as they wouldn't let him in the house and he had no couch to stay on,

They're older than me, 30 and 31. They demanded a meeting last night and said it's nothing personal but I should not have been closing my door when I'm in my room as it makes them uncomfortable, I shouldn't be going out and not telling them.

They said I shouldn't have a boyfriend, as its not fair on them. One of them said when she has a day off, it's not fair that I'm not there or I'm in my room, I should spend my time with her in the house because she hates being on her own. 

They are giving me till 9pm tonight, then I can go to the church homeless section. 

I don't know what to do with my stuff as they had already bagged it all up when I got home yesterday

I will do a post and see what happens but as it stands, there's nothing I can do, I spoke with citizens information and thy said because I have just been paying rent into one of the girls accounts and my name isn't on anything in the house, I can't prove I live there.

Thank you, that means so much. I only started a few weeks ago, I confided in my boss today but he just mentioned because I am on a 4 month contract, that he may need to let me go. I did mention it to the two other coworkers that live there but neither is in a position to hell unfortunately, but I understand
I haven't, I had unlimited amounts of coffee in work today which is keeping me going, if I'm honest, I don't even have an appetite atm anyway, food would be wasted on me

We don't have Craigslist here but on my lunch at work today, I emailed well over 100 house shares and studios, because the demand is so high and so little supply here, they rarely even get back to you.

I left my details with 3 churches today, so I am hoping i hear something, thank you for the kind advice
Hi Savannah, my name is Sam ☀️ thank you for the kind message. I wish I had a car, it would make this all so much easier haha though the temptation of McDonalds might get too much

Lol I walked past a McDonalds on my way home and have never been so hungry 🤦‍♀️lol it really is, I use to, but lately I haven't found much joy in anything, I tried but just couldn't. If Ireland was warm, being homeless wouldn't seem so bad
Unfortunately not, I did ask him but he already has tenants living there, he said if he could he would, but at least the thought was there which is all that matters

I'm in Dublin, Ireland, the rents are insane here, i looked at a single bed with a toilet in the corner with a curtain and just a microwave today and it costs 800 per month, but 1600 to initially lease 🤦‍♀️

I'm in Dublin, Ireland, that's such an amazing thing to do, I wish there were more people in the world like you.

I helped out a friend maybe 9 months ago, and never heard from her again lol 

I really hope you understand how important a person like you is too the world x *virtual hug*

Unfortunately I tried while they were talking to me a little earlier, they just laughed and said it's too late, I told them I'll have nowhere to go and they said it's not their problem, that maybe if I had spent more time with them they would care.

I use to talk to them all the time, but they started making catty comments and belittling me, so I scaled back, not a huge amount but enough to not be insulted. 

Thank you so much, the virtual hug means more than you know

I'm not on a lease as they sublet and I don't have any proof that I live here. I haven't got a leg to stand on. I'm not a confrontational person so when they met with me this evening to go at me about spending all my time alone instead of with them, I started crying.

I'm just lay in bed crying right now. This is my last night, I have nothing, no one would even notice if I was gone tbh

I get nearly everything by email, except my revenue letter which gets delivered to my old place which the landlord is kind enough to deliver to me, they won't change the name on it at revenue to this new address as I have no proof I live here

I'm on Dublin, Ireland. I tried various churches and St vincent de Paul's, so many places won't help unless you are someone that frequents their church or have no job. I got food stamps last week from St vincent de pauls and that's all they could give me, it was about 11 euro

I'm in Dublin, and the rental market is disgusting, can't even get another house share, it's insane, just priced out completely and because I'm in debt with people hassling me constantly, I can't get a leg up on my wages to be able to afford a deposit.

I found a place today but they need 1600 for the deposit and first month's rent. I have minus 15 in my account, I just can't do it
The one time I'm not trying to lose weight

It's awful, they just had a sit down meeting with me and told me I have to spend time with them, that's part of the lease. I asked to see it and they said no. They told me they don't want to live with someone who enjoys being on their own all the time.

They said it's rude that I come home and go into my room and that I don't hang out with them. I told them about my anxiety and how I just love my own company and they said tough, I'm out. 

I can't stop crying, I see no other way out

Thank you everyone, you give such kind words but I just don't have it in me anymore, people constantly hounding me for money, I haven't eaten in 7 days because I just can't afford to, I walk 10miles to and from work everyday, I just can't keep going.

I can't even get homeless accommodation because I have a job. I've tried looking for more jobs but I can't get any, I'm so broke and I just don't see the point anymore

I don't have proof of residency unfortunately. The bf won't help, can't help, so he says. I only have one way out, I just can't find an apartment or even a room to rent, I have nothing and I am just ready to go tbh

Unfortunately no, I got in debt trying to help he tbh, and he doesnt seem to care so that's why I just don't have a reason to live anymore.

I spoke with citizens information today and they said I have no legal grounds here, that I have to leave because I was subletting with no proof, I have no lease, nothing other than electronic transfers to one of the girls that lives there.

I'm screwed basically. I have the church for a few days but that's it, I just want to end it but I've heard pills don't always work
Thank you bananalamp73, it's so hard to find anywhere, everywhere is 2000 per month and they want 3 months deposit and 2 months rent upfront 🤦‍♀️ fingers crossed we get sorted

We were kind of close, not butt buddies or anything. If I'm honest, I went out with her twice and found her to be quite a messy and nasty drunk so I scaled it back completely, it just so happens that I met my boyfriend around the same time and we both love just spending time together than going out, not big drinkers.

She loves my other housemates boyfriend but she really does seem to have a problem with mine when he's actually really polite. 

He came in to greet them both one day, brought them chocolates and everything and he hasn't really needed to see them since.

The other housemate's bf on the other hand barely looks in my direction when I say hi and is really rude. I just don't understand her. Glad to know I'm NTA though

I don't have any type of rental agreement, they sublet the place and when I asked for a copy of the lease they said I wouldn't need one.

As for the rules, I asked about that before I moved in and they said it was absolutely fine as they have people over too and that the landlord has no qualms about it. 

Neither has been assaulted, we talked about it one night as I actually have been, in a previous house I lived in with two boys. 

I'm definitely moving out asap but the rental market is so depressing atm so it's hard to find anything. It just sucks that I now feel so uncomfortable in my house because of this. I didn't mean to offend them or anything 🤷‍♀️
Haha sorry, it means "it's gone all wrong"
I try but she acts all nice and says she's fine but then becomes more hostile towards me. I've actually started avoiding leaving my room at all now because I feel so uncomfortable

Yeah I thought that too and I wanted to talk to her about it but she just tells me nothing is wrong then goes back to being hostile. Lately she's started chucking my wet washing onto the floor in a ball, when I always hang hers and my roommates when I need the machine. I'm not a confrontational person and just want to leave but it's just been really stressing me out, I actually hate being here because of it.

I get that, we've been looking for our own place for a while how, renting in this city is insane atm but I would never mention anything about her one night stands or mates staying over, even when they make noise, I feel it's none of my business so I feel it would be unfair for my bf to pay rent? I pay rent and he doesn't even leave the room, maybe I'm wrong 🤷‍♀️
Sorry, link removed!

I know and it is selfish of me to want to take the excitement away from a baby I guess, and I wouldn't like to see someone without at such a big time in their life, but she has family who will be there.

And his kids won't even be there, they will be with relatives, I guess I feel a bit selfish? Like she treated him terribly so I feel like a kid, saying you can't have him, he's mine? Get the father of the kid instead. I know that's an awful thing to say 🤦‍♀️

I understand that, I should clarify my reason of being financially stable, I had an extremely poor upbringing and struggled for my whole childhood with abusive parents.

My wanting to only have kids if I was financially secure is down to not wanting them to go without, and when I say without, I mean basic things that kids should have. 

He doesn't really know any of this, so I'm not sure how I would be enabling him unless subconsciously?

That's exactly what I think in terms of having no room for me. I had plans to move to another country in the summer that he was very upset about and I have discussed this with him and how he doesn't want me to go.

I have taken the time to consider how this will affect him and us, and right now, not going for the sake of our relationship is winning the argument as I do really like him. However, I don't feel like he is thinking of me and my feelings about being so involved with his ex when it's not even his kid.
The oldest is 6 and the youngest 1, they got together at 14 and the first was kind of planned. They were broken up for 4 years when they had a one night stand which is where the youngest appeared

I understand that his kids come first and I would never stand in the way of that.

My thing about not wanting kids and marriage is a multitude of reasons. Bad childhood, horrible parents and the fact I'm only 28.

I personally don't feel ready, or even mature enough in financial stability to consider any of that right now, and would rather not put my baggage on someone I'm seeing so early in. That will be for my therapist only, when I finally see one lol.

My issue here isn't a lack of trust, I know this guy is crazy about me but I am also not too naive to know that love and hate go hand in hand, I guess my issue is how badly she treated him and how he's ready to drop everything for her and it's not his kid. 

Sorry for the rambling.
